slides.title: An easier ATAK
slides.html: ATAK, the map app TAK users share positions and marks on, is built for every possible user, so one enemy mark takes many taps. OpenDefence Main is a plugin for ATAK that does the common things in a few taps: mark the enemy, send the mark and read what others report.

slides.title: Plugins join in
slides.html: OpenDefence Main's buttons sit on the thumb bar at the bottom left of the map: Inbox on top and Markers below. Other OpenDefence plugins add their buttons beside Markers, such as Drones from OpenDefence UAVOps and Voice from OpenDefence Voice. What they send you, such as the answer to a drone request, shows in the same Inbox.

slides.title: One way of working, shared
slides.html: Learn Markers, Send to…, where you share a mark, and the Inbox once. Plugins that build on them, such as Drones, work through them the same way.

slides.title: Built for military use
slides.html: Markers draws NATO's standard military symbols (APP-6D), and every mark goes out in TAK's standard format. Users of plain ATAK, of WinTAK on Windows and of iTAK on iPhone, allies included, see the right symbol without OpenDefence Main. Your admins pick the types that come first for the whole operation, like these enemy favourites.
